entries.scope: G3 no-IALMob Id-Vg, Vd=0.1 V, exact SProcess topology, Vg=0--5 V; dominant unresolved interval Vg=0--0.6667 V
entries.observation: The qualified contact-boundary ElectricField HFS fallback reduces the three-point fixed-state median error from 1.04443 dex to 0.0196168 dex. After repairing the constant_field cached-mobility Jacobian, all 31 no-predictor points converge and the worst KCL relative error is 7.96e-6, but the self-consistent P95 current error is 0.432753 dex and the fixed-current equivalent threshold shift is 43.2055 mV. Vg=0.1667--0.6667 V retains a nearly multiplicative Vela/Sentaurus current factor of 2.61--2.73, while the strong-inversion endpoint error is only 1.51 percent. The contact-HFS support and WP1.5 numerical trajectory are therefore closed, but the remaining coefficient/state-feedback difference is not yet an approved engine floor.
excluded_causes: uniform electrostatic, flatband, or reference-energy offset
electron-density reconstruction from psi and QF
mixed-Voronoi node volume in fixed-state SG replay
WP1.5 low-current KCL and line-search floor
missing contact-boundary ElectricField fallback as the sole remaining cause
constant_field cached-mobility Jacobian mismatch as a physical curve-amplitude cause
open_causes: LDMOS-specific SG box-coefficient or edge-coupling semantics beyond the existing cotangent and mixed-volume controls
self-consistent state feedback associated with the remaining coefficient difference
generalized SRH hole-QF reference convention; low impact on current Id-Vg but material for recombination qualification
entries.expires_when: An LDMOS-specific coefficient/edge-coupling A/B and matched self-consistent state audit either closes the 2.61--2.73 current factor or proves a mesh-converged engine difference; generalized SRH reference semantics are independently requalified, or the exact mesh/discretization contract changes.
